title: Cloud Pulse API unreachable
description: Notifies when the check cannot collect Cloud Pulse metrics, most often because the personal access token expired or lost a scope.

definition.name: [Akamai Cloud Pulse] Cannot collect {{service_type.name}} metrics
definition.message:
The Agent could not collect Akamai Cloud Pulse metrics for `{{service_type.name}}`.

{{check_message}}

To resolve:
1. Confirm the personal access token has not expired.
2. Confirm it has `monitor:read_only` and read-only access to the service.
3. Run `datadog-agent check akamai_cloud_pulse` on the Agent host.
